plainTranslation: Intensity and control surfacing through the relationship itself. Power tilts back and forth: who needs whom, who holds the cards. Failure mode: a tug-of-war over closeness and control that neither will name. Put the dynamic on the table and even it out, or step back - intense doesn't excuse domination.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
